1
Running the AC in a Server
We can easily run the AC in a server.
The script must be adapted to have no user interaction, otherwise the application will fall.
It is very important to know that the application is just watching a folder and running a script that was
previously defined.
Every action like (Save file, log message, errors) must be manage in the script).
The application will just run what you asked for.
All files can be found on C:\Program Files\OPEN MIND\hyperMILL\#version#\addins\hmAutoColor
PW server configuration (PWserver.exe)
There is one executable file where we can define:
• Watch folder
• Project number (script to be executed)
• Priority
• File type
The watch folder must be a folder accessibly by all clients and server

-- 1 of 10 --

PW Monitor configuration (PWMonitor.exe)
We can use the monitor to show some information to the client during the process.
The log file must have the extension (.PWlog)
The monitor will be started by the client
The script will manage what will be populated in the monitor and when it will be populated

Starting the application from the client (PWserverStart.exe)
We can start the server application directly by the client.
In this case we can use the function “Start script on server” exactly where we want to start the server.

7
Batch mode
In case of some message box appears during the process, the application will be stopped.
To avoid this problem, we can use the function “Batch mode”.
It will skip all message boxes.
